ax6.src:
paper square
mark (map .a onto .b) as --ef
mark (through .b .d) as --bd
.p = free on --bd from .d at 1/4
fold (map .d onto --ef through .p toward TOWARD) as --s

ax7.src:
paper square
mark (through .a .c) as --diag
mark (through .b .d) as --anti
mark (map .a onto --anti and .d onto --diag toward TOWARD)

ax5e.src:
paper square
mark (map .a onto .b) as --v
mark (map --v onto --ab toward TOWARD) as --k

ax5c.src:
paper square
mark (map .a onto .b) as --v
mark (map .a onto .d) as --h
mark (map --v onto --h toward TOWARD) as --k

ax5o.src:
paper square
mark (map .a onto .b) as --v
.m = --v * --ab
mark (through .m .c) as --mc
mark (through .b .d) as --bd
.t = free on --bd from .b at 2/5
mark (map --mc onto --ab toward TOWARD) as --k
